Implement ci-deadcode-removal-rotation workflow (#3015)

* Persist skip reason

* Add ci-deadcode-removal-rotation helper scripts

Implements deterministic pre-activation logic:
- dual deadcode execution, intersection, cooldown filtering
- deterministic one-candidate selection with gopls reference analysis
- acceptance-style exclusion via acc_*test.go filename rule
- cooldown memory with deterministic reason codes
- local verification (make build + impacted package unit tests)
- focused unit tests for parsing, selection, references, memory

* Add ci-deadcode-removal-rotation GitHub Agentic Workflow

- Authored workflow source under .github/workflows-src/
- Compiled artifacts (.md and .lock.yml) regenerated
- Scheduled execution with deterministic pre-activation
- Agent prompt with acceptance-test backstop and verification contract
- Safe-outputs create-pull-request configured for one PR per run

* Document ci-deadcode-removal-rotation workflow and mark tasks complete

- Maintainer-facing README covering scope, rules, verification, cooldown,
  reason codes, outcome summaries, and manual review expectations
- Update OpenSpec task checkboxes for completed implementation

* fix(ci-deadcode-removal-rotation): address local review findings

- Fix lint issues: remove unused verify command, rename 'max' param to avoid builtin shadow
- Fix runDeadcode/runGoplsReferences error handling so non-zero exit with unusable output is not silently swallowed
- Add unit tests for parseGoplsReferencesOutput, derivePackagePath, impactedPackages
- Remove unused verify.go since workflow runs verification inline via agent prompts
- Improve root package path handling in impactedPackages to avoid './.'

* fix(ci-deadcode-removal-rotation): address copilot review feedback

- Fix classifyReferences to reject candidates with non-test reference files
- Add stable tie-breaker (package path) to sticky-package sort in summarize
- Add symbol_name field to Candidate for bare symbol name in workflow prompts
- Add test for mixed test/non-test reference classification
- Recompile workflow from template

* fix(ci-deadcode-removal-rotation): modernize lint issues in memory.go

- Use omitzero instead of omitempty for nested struct field (AttemptContext)
- Use slices.Backward for reverse iteration over attempts
- Use slices.SortFunc instead of sort.Slice for reason codes and sticky packages

* fix: gofmt trailing blank lines and gitignore binary

* chore(openspec): archive ci-deadcode-removal-rotation via verify-openspec

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: trigger checks

* fix(ci-deadcode-removal-rotation): initialize repo memory in pre-activation

* go tool deadcode

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,225 @@
+---
+# This file is generated by `scripts/compile-workflow-sources/main.go` from `.github/workflows-src/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/workflow.md.tmpl`. Do not edit directly.
+name: Dead-code Removal Rotation
+description: >-
+  Scheduled dead-code cleanup workflow that rotates through highest-confidence
+  deadcode candidates (dead with and without tests), performs deterministic
+  pre-activation selection, reference classification, and opens at most one
+  verified cleanup PR per run.
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: daily
+  steps:
+    - name: Checkout repository
+      uses: actions/checkout@v6
+      with:
+        persist-credentials: false
+        fetch-depth: 1
+    - name: Setup Go
+      uses: actions/setup-go@v6
+      with:
+        go-version-file: go.mod
+        cache: false
+    # NOTE: This ref must match the repo-memory tool config branch-name below.
+    - name: Checkout repo-memory branch
+      uses: actions/checkout@v6
+      with:
+        ref: memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation
+        path: gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation
+        fetch-depth: 1
+        persist-credentials: false
+      continue-on-error: true
+    - name: Export Go paths
+      run: |
+        echo "GOROOT=$(go env GOROOT)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+        echo "GOPATH=$(go env GOPATH)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+        echo "GOMODCACHE=$(go env GOMODCACHE)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+    - name: Ensure gopls is available
+      run: |
+        if ! command -v gopls &> /dev/null; then
+          go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
+        fi
+    - name: Select dead-code candidate
+      id: select_candidate
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        result=$(go run ./scripts/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation select \
+          --memory gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json \
+          --cooldown-days 14)
+        echo "$result"
+        found=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.found')
+        echo "found=$found" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+        if [ "$found" = "true" ]; then
+          echo "symbol=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.symbol')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "symbol_name=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.symbol_name')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "package=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.package')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "file=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.file')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "line=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.line')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "column=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.column')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "companion_test_cleanup_eligible=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.companion_test_cleanup_eligible')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "companion_test_file=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.companion_test_file')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "impacted_packages=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.impacted_packages | join(" ")')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "reference_files=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.reference_files | join(" ")')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "reference_file_count=$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.reference_files | length')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+        fi
+    - name: Summarize recent outcomes
+      id: summarize
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        if [ -f gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json ]; then
+          summary=$(go run ./scripts/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation summarize \
+            --memory gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json \
+            --days 30)
+        else
+          summary="No previous attempt memory."
+        fi
+        echo "summary<<EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+        echo "$summary" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+        echo "EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+engine:
+  id: claude
+  model: "llm-gateway/claude-sonnet-4-6"
+  args:
+    - "--effort"
+    - "high"
+  env:
+    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: "https://elastic.litellm-prod.ai/"
+    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY }}
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: read
+  pull-requests: read
+tools:
+  timeout: 600
+  repo-memory:
+    - id: ci-deadcode-removal-rotation
+      # NOTE: This branch name must match the repo-memory checkout step above.
+      branch-name: memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation
+      file-glob: ["memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json"]
+      create-orphan: true
+      max-file-size: 524288
+      max-patch-size: 102400
+safe-outputs:
+  create-pull-request:
+    labels: [deadcode-cleanup, automated-cleanup]
+    max: 1
+    patch-format: am
+  noop:
+    max: 1
+    report-as-issue: false
+network:
+  allowed: [defaults, node, go, elastic.litellm-prod.ai]
+if: >-
+  needs.pre_activation.outputs.found == 'true'
+steps:
+  - name: Setup repository dependencies
+    run: make setup
+jobs:
+  pre-activation:
+    outputs:
+      found: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.found }}
+      symbol: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.symbol }}
+      symbol_name: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.symbol_name }}
+      package: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.package }}
+      file: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.file }}
+      line: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.line }}
+      column: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.column }}
+      companion_test_cleanup_eligible: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.companion_test_cleanup_eligible }}
+      companion_test_file: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.companion_test_file }}
+      impacted_packages: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.impacted_packages }}
+      reference_files: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.reference_files }}
+      reference_file_count: ${{ steps.select_candidate.outputs.reference_file_count }}
+      summary: ${{ steps.summarize.outputs.summary }}
+---
+
+# Dead-code Removal Rotation Worker
+
+You are responsible for safely removing one dead-code candidate per run and opening a verified cleanup PR.
+
+## Pre-activation context
+
+A deterministic pre-activation step has already selected the candidate and analyzed its references. Use only the values below.
+
+- **Candidate found**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.found }}`
+- **Symbol**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.symbol }}`
+- **Package**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.package }}`
+- **File**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.file }}`
+- **Line**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.line }}`
+- **Column**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.column }}`
+- **Companion test cleanup eligible**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.companion_test_cleanup_eligible }}`
+- **Companion test file**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.companion_test_file }}`
+- **Impacted packages**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.impacted_packages }}`
+- **Reference files**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.reference_files }}`
+- **Reference file count**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.reference_file_count }}`
+
+## Recent outcome summary
+
+```
+${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.summary }}
+```
+
+## Task
+
+1. **Read the candidate file** (`${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.file }}`) and locate the dead function at line `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.line }}`.
+2. **Remove the dead function** including its doc comment block. Ensure the file remains syntactically valid.
+3. **Companion test cleanup (conditional)**:
+   - Only if `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.companion_test_cleanup_eligible }}` is `true`:
+     - Read the companion test file `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.companion_test_file }}`.
+     - **Before deleting any tests**, search the file for the strings `resource.Test` or `resource.ParallelTest`.
+     - If either string is present, **abort immediately** without making any changes.
+       - Record the attempt as `invalid_candidate_acceptance_test` using:
+         ```
+         go run ./scripts/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation record \
+           --memory gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json \
+           --symbol "${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.symbol }}" \
+           --package "${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.package }}" \
+           --reason invalid_candidate_acceptance_test \
+           --context '{"referenceFileCount":${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.reference_file_count }},"testCleanupEligible":true}'
+         ```
+       - Then call `noop` with a concise reason.
+     - If the backstop passes, remove only the test functions that reference `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.symbol_name }}` (and their doc comments).
+   - If `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.companion_test_cleanup_eligible }}` is `false`:
+     - Do **not** delete any tests. Only remove the dead symbol.
+4. **Verify** the cleanup before opening a PR:
+   - Run `timeout 600 make build` (10-minute timeout). If it fails or times out:
+     - Record the attempt as `build_failed` (or `verification_timeout` on timeout):
+       ```
+       go run ./scripts/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation record \
+         --memory gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json \
+         --symbol "${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.symbol }}" \
+         --package "${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.package }}" \
+         --reason <reason>
+       ```
+     - Stop without creating a PR.
+   - Run unit tests for the impacted packages:
+     ```
+     go test -v ${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.impacted_packages }}
+     ```
+     If any test fails:
+     - Record the attempt as `tests_failed`.
+     - Stop without creating a PR.
+5. **Open a cleanup PR** using the `create-pull-request` safe output **only** if verification succeeds.
+   - Title format: `[deadcode] Remove ${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.symbol }}`
+   - Body must include:
+     - A short description of the removed symbol.
+     - The recent outcome summary.
+     - A note that the PR was generated by the dead-code removal rotation workflow and that maintainers should review, merge, or close it manually.
+6. **Record success** after opening the PR:
+   ```
+   go run ./scripts/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation record \
+     --memory gh-aw-repo-memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory/ci-deadcode-removal-rotation/memory.json \
+     --symbol "${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.symbol }}" \
+     --package "${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.package }}" \
+     --reason pr_created \
+     --context '{"referenceFileCount":${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.reference_file_count }},"testCleanupEligible":${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.companion_test_cleanup_eligible }}}'
+   ```
+7. If you cannot safely proceed at any point, record the appropriate reason code and call `noop`.
+
+## Guardrails
+
+- Never modify more than one dead symbol per run.
+- Never delete tests unless pre-activation has explicitly marked the candidate as eligible for companion test cleanup.
+- Never bypass the `resource.Test` / `resource.ParallelTest` backstop.
+- Do not open a PR if verification fails.
+- Keep changes minimal and focused.

feat(gh-aw): extract shared setup-dev component from 9 agentic workflow templates (#3076)

* feat(gh-aw): add shared setup-dev.yml workflow component

Creates .github/workflows/shared/setup-dev.yml as a reusable GH-AW
import that unconditionally installs Go, Terraform CLI, Node.js, exports
chroot paths (GOROOT, GOPATH, GOMODCACHE, TERRAFORM_BIN), and runs
make setup. Has no on: field so it is never compiled as a standalone
workflow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(gh-aw): add imports and remove duplicated setup steps from 9 templates

Adds imports: [shared/setup-dev.yml] to the frontmatter of all 9 agentic
workflow templates and deletes the agent-phase setup steps that the shared
component now covers (Setup Go, Export Go paths, Setup Terraform, Setup
Node.js, make setup). Also removes non-functional Elastic Stack scaffolding
(make docker-fleet, set-kibana-password, create-es-api-key, setup-kibana-fleet,
docker compose logs) from code-factory-issue and reproducer-factory-issue.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(gh-aw): rename shared component to .md and update all imports

Rename shared/setup-dev.yml to shared/setup-dev.md with GH-AW
frontmatter format (the gh-aw compiler requires .md for import files,
not .yml). Update all 9 workflow templates to reference the .md file.
Regenerate all compiled .md and .lock.yml files with make workflow-generate
and gh aw compile --approve (approving the new hashicorp/setup-terraform
action newly injected via the shared import into workflows that previously
did not include it).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(gh-aw): update workflow tests to verify setup steps in lock files

After shared setup-dev.md import, setup steps no longer appear in
compiled .md files — they are inlined into .lock.yml only. Update
openspec-verify-label, schema-coverage-rotation-bootstrap, and
change-factory-issue test files to assert step presence in lockSource()
and import declaration in workflowSource().

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(openspec): mark gh-aw-shared-setup-dev tasks complete

* fix(gh-aw): update reproducer-factory-issue prompt for inaccessible stack

The Elastic Stack setup steps were removed from the agent phase (AWF
network policy blocks access from chroot anyway). Update the agent
prompt to match: acknowledge the stack is not reachable, route outcomes
by static analysis rather than live test execution, matching the
treatment already applied to code-factory-issue.

* docs(openspec): update gh-aw-shared-setup-dev artifacts to use .md extension

* fix(gh-aw): address Copilot review feedback on reproducer prompt and setup-dev guard

- Update reproducer-factory-issue prompt: clarify the Elastic Stack is NOT
  provisioned (all provisioning steps were removed); remove the stale
  acceptance-test invocation block that referenced a live stack
- Remove the now-unnecessary `if [ -x "$(which terraform)" ]` guard from
  setup-dev.md: terraform is always installed by the preceding step, so the
  conditional was dead code that contradicted the proposal.md description
- Regenerate all compiled .md and .lock.yml files

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(openspec): archive gh-aw-shared-setup-dev via verify-openspec

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: trigger checks
